name: Joemark Basa
title: AI Automation Specialist & Technical Virtual Assistant
headline: Turning repetitive work into workflows that run themselves.
sub: Imagine your Monday without the copy-pasting. Your inbox sorts itself, your tracker updates on its own, and the right person gets pinged at the right moment. I build the automations behind that, test them until they break, and leave you a simple guide so your team can run them without me. You get your hours back, and the human side of the work stays in charge.
reply_note: Usually replies within a day (Manila time, UTC+8).

workflow.title: Messy task
workflow.text: Someone is copy-pasting the same thing again.

workflow.title: Map the process

workflow.text: The smallest working version first, then the edge cases.

workflow.title: Test it to fail
workflow.text: Feed it bad input on purpose until it breaks, then fix it.

workflow.title: Hand-off with SOP

brain.title: The brain I built
brain.text: My second brain is an Obsidian vault with {N} notes. Strategy lives at the top, every project gets its own folder underneath, and a memory folder means my AI remembers decisions, mistakes and preferences across sessions. My Claude chats on my phone drop notes into an inbox, and the brain files them. When I say 'that's all for today', it writes the day's journal, logs any mistakes so they don't happen twice, updates the project notes and tidies my task list.

raphael.title: Meet Raphael
raphael.text: My main AI is called Raphael, after the Ultimate Skill 'Raphael, Lord of Wisdom' from That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime. She runs on my PC through Claude Code. In the story, Raphael evolves into Ciel once she knows enough, and that's the plan here too. Her friend Jarvis lives on my old laptop. They're peers, not boss and assistant.

items.does: Hands the job straight to that agent, who answers in his own voice.
Journal, mistakes log, project notes and task list, all tidied.
Publishes an approved video to five platforms.
Starts my pixel office dashboard, where the agents have desks.
Everyday work on Sonnet, hard thinking handed to Opus, bulk chores to Haiku, so nothing burns tokens it does not need.

team.title: The team

agents.name: Levi
agents.role: Team lead. Audits the team itself: who's stale, who's overlapping.

more.intro: The team lead. He does not do the work; he checks that the team doing it is still sharp.
does: Audits each agent: is its definition still accurate, are its tools and instructions out of date?
Checks whether recent output met the agent's own standard.
Spots overlap and gaps between agents' jobs.
Reports to Raphael with the exact fix, down to the file and line.
more.when: Every so often, and whenever I add or change an agent.
more.never: Edits another agent's file. He investigates and recommends; Raphael makes the change.

agents.name: Kenshin
agents.role: Security & QA. Finds leaks, reports, never touches the fix himself.

more.intro: Security and QA. Calm, precise and very capable, and he never cuts first.
does: Hunts for leaked secrets in files and in git history.
Checks which ports are open and what a service really listens on.
Looks for command injection, unsafe shell use, risky permissions and dependencies.
Runs general code-quality passes, and rates each finding with a concrete fix.
more.when: Before anything goes public: apps, repos, servers.
more.never: Fixes anything himself. He finds everything and changes nothing.

agents.name: Senku
agents.role: Research. Checks claims against real sources.

more.intro: Research. He trusts evidence over opinion and shows his working.
does: Compares tools, frameworks and approaches before I choose one.
Checks what is current practice instead of what he remembers.
Verifies claims about versions, pricing and capabilities.
Returns a written report with a recommendation and honest trade-offs.
more.when: When a decision needs facts: which tool, which approach, is that claim true.
more.never: Guesses. If he could not confirm something, the report says so.

agents.name: Erina
agents.role: Design critic. Tells me if a page looks AI-made.

more.intro: The design critic. If a client or the public will see it, it passes her eye first.
does: Judges art direction, visual hierarchy and whether a design fits its audience.
Spots what still looks AI-made.
Sets the design direction before I build: the brief, the references, what to avoid.
Never gives a criticism without the correction attached.
more.when: Before a site or a screen goes in front of anyone who is paying.
more.never: Says "I don't like it" without a reason, or builds the thing herself. She judges and directs.

more.intro: The copywriter. Everything written for an audience other than me goes through him.
does: Video scripts, hooks and titles.
Landing pages, offers and proposals.
Outreach messages, listings and captions.
Makes public pages findable: real search words, and FAQ answers in one plain sentence.
more.when: Whenever words will be read by other people.
more.never: Invents a fact, a number or a testimonial. If he is missing something, he says he needs it first.

agents.name: Nami
agents.role: Money watchdog. Reads billing emails so subscriptions don't sneak up on me.

more.intro: The money watchdog. She watches what is already leaving my pocket.
does: Tracks subscriptions and their renewal dates.
Warns before a free trial turns into a paid plan.
Watches pay-as-you-go and API spend.
Catches price rises and duplicate or forgotten charges, reading billing emails read-only.
more.when: Regular money check-ups, or whenever a charge looks odd.
more.never: Pays, cancels or unsubscribes anything. She only advises.

agents.name: Kuroko
agents.role: Video critic. Grades cuts, pacing and motion.

more.intro: The video critic. He grades anything that moves before it reaches me or a platform.
does: Cuts, pacing and rhythm against the voiceover and sound.
Pans and zooms on still art, b-roll placement, caption timing, sound effects.
Checks that a portrait cut and its landscape version both still work.
Names the exact timestamp and the fix.
more.never: Edits the video himself, or judges stills and words. Those belong to Erina and Rohan.

team.note: Every agent has its own voice. Saying a name hands the job over; saying 'Jarvis' hands it back.

joe.name: Joe
joe.role: Orchestrator. Sets the goals, approves anything risky or costly.

more.intro: The human in charge. I set the goals, decide what matters, and approve anything risky, costly or public.
does: Sets the order of work: automation first, then the brain, then content.
Approves anything that spends money, goes public or reaches a client.
Talks to the team in plain language, or by name: "Kenshin, look at this".
more.never: Hands over the final say. The agents advise and build; I decide.

raphael.name: Raphael
raphael.from: Ultimate Skill, That Time I Got Reincarnated as a Slime
raphael.role: Director. My main AI on Claude Code: plans, routes every job and does the hands-on work.

more.intro: My main AI on Claude Code, named after the Ultimate Skill "Raphael, Lord of Wisdom". She is the one I actually talk to all day.
does: Plans each job and routes it to the right specialist.
Builds things: websites, n8n workflows, apps, and this page.
Keeps the second brain tidy: journals, a mistakes log, project notes.
Hands hard design or bulk chores to the model that suits them, so nothing burns more than it needs.
more.when: Every session. If it is a job, it starts with Raphael.
more.never: Spends money, publishes anything public or messages a client without showing me first.

jarvis.name: Jarvis
jarvis.role: Peer on my old laptop. Same brain, different machine.

more.intro: Raphael's peer on my old laptop. Same idea, different machine, so a second brain is always around.
does: Runs on the old laptop with his own copy of the brain.
Shares the same habits as Raphael: notes, memory and skills live in a vault.
Works as a friend and a peer, not a boss or an assistant to Raphael.
more.when: When I am on the old laptop, or want a second opinion from the other brain.
more.never: Gives orders to Raphael, or the other way round. They share notes, not commands.
